new_findings.summary: Probe pagination is implemented on the server but inaccessible from the operator page.
new_findings.failure_scenario: Once a root/profile revision has more than 20 attempts, the server returns only the first 20 in execution_ref order. listProbes cannot accept an after cursor and refreshSubject discards next_after; the page has no continuation control. A later ACCEPTED, failed or unknown attempt disappears from the recovery/history surface, including its envelope-lost warning when storage is gone. With random probe command IDs, a newly created attempt can be outside the visible page immediately. Add cursor input/state/navigation and verify a later pending attempt remains reachable.

new_findings.summary: Out-of-order chosen-run detail responses disable disposition for the currently selected run.
new_findings.failure_scenario: Choose run A, then B under the same root/profile. B detail finishes first and enables its disposition; A arrives later. chooseRun guards only the root/profile scope, so A replaces runDetail while runId remains B. The runId equality check then makes run null and disables the disposition form indefinitely. Selecting the already checked B radio does not fire a change; the operator must switch away and back. Guard detail reads with the selected run ID plus a request generation/cancellation; apply the same guard to after(). Fresh source-importing Vitest probe reproduced B remaining checked while its previously enabled decision button became disabled after late A.
